user.title: Set up Music Manager
user.description: The card and connector are installed together. The dashboard resource is registered automatically; reload Home Assistant afterwards. Start with radio only or select the existing Music Assistant connection for Apple Music. Then open Configure to assign personal accounts.

error.cannot_connect: Music Assistant is unavailable or this connection cannot read users.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Music Manager is already configured. Open Configure to manage account assignments.
abort.music_assistant_missing: Set up the official Music Assistant integration first.

add.title: Assign personal Apple Music account
add.description: 1 HA user = 1 MA user = 1 Apple Music provider instance. Create an active normal MA user, not an administrator, and restrict their music sources to exactly this Apple Music instance.

data.provider_id: Apple Music account in Music Assistant

remove.title: Remove assignment
remove.description: The selected HA user loses Apple Music access through this card. Radio favorites remain available.

connect.title: Connect Music Assistant
connect.description: Select the existing Music Assistant connection. Switching to another connection or to radio only clears Apple Music account assignments so they can be set up again. Radio favorites are preserved.

error.invalid_account: Select valid entries from the lists.
error.duplicate_account: This MA user or Apple Music instance is already assigned to another HA user.
error.account_filter: The MA user must be active, have the user role and be restricted to exactly the selected Apple Music source.
error.cannot_connect: Music Assistant is unavailable or this connection cannot read users.

abort.accounts_missing: Add an Apple Music provider instance and an active normal user in Music Assistant first.
abort.cannot_connect: Music Assistant is unavailable or this connection cannot read users.
abort.no_accounts: No accounts have been assigned yet.
abort.music_assistant_missing: First connect Music Assistant under Configure → Music Assistant connection. Radio already works.
